results.name: Valcamonica, Seradina 2 - Rock 28 (1)
results.description:
This rock is situated in a panoramic position overlooking Capo di Ponte.  It has long been known for its two clear depictions of sheathed knives (not shown on this model), with characteristic 'anchor-shaped' tips.  the two pbjectes are comparable to knives dating from the Late Iron age -  Roman period (2nd century BC to 2nd century AD) found in Roman tombs in Valcamonica (Lovere, Borno) and from the Central Alps more generally.

Unusually, the knives here have been executed by pecking the rock, whereas where this type of knife has been found depicted elsewhere in Valcamonica it has been created by the graffiti technique - scratching or incising the rock surface.

This portion of the rock on the model shows a row of square-bodied warriors, probably contemporary with the knives.  These have been placed within the prominent water run-off channel at the bottom of the rock.  Towards the right hand side these superimpose several other carvings, including two buildings of differing sizes.
